2026-03-20).\n142\t        #[arg(long)]\n143\t        since: Option<String>,\n144\t\n145\t        /// Filter events until this time (e.g., 1h, 24h, 7d, 2026-03-20T15:00:00Z).\n146\t        #[arg(long)]\n147\t        until: Option<String>,\n148\t\n149\t        /// Show cooldown state for idle-time strands (reflect, weave, pulse, unravel).\n150\t        #[arg(long)]\n151\t #[arg(short = 'o', long)]\n267\t        output: Option<PathBuf>,\n268\t    },\n269\t\n270\t    /// Show outcome statistics aggregated from telemetry logs.\n271\t    ///\n272\t    /// Reads JSONL #[arg(long)]\n286\t        since: Option<String>,\n287\t\n288\t        /// Include only events until this time (e.g., 1h, 24h, 7d, 2026-03-20T15:00:00Z).\n289\t        #[arg(long)]\n290\t        until: Option<String>,\n291\t\n292\t        /// Output format.\n293\t        #[arg(long, value_enum, default_value = \"table\")]\n294\t        format: ListFormat,\n295\t    },\n296\t\n297\t    /// Run long)]\n301\t        workspace: Option<PathBuf>,\n302\t    },\n303\t}\n304\t\n305\t/// Output format for the list command.\n306\t#[derive(Debug, Clone, ValueEnum)]\n307\tpub enum ListFormat {\n308\t    Table,\n309\t    Json,\n310\t}\n311\t\n312\t/// Output format for the logs command.\n313\t#[derive(Debug, Clone, ValueEnum)]\n314\tpub enum LogFormat {\n315\t    /// Human-readable table format #[value(name = \"task_type\")]\n333\t    TaskType,\n334\t    /// Group by worker identifier (e.g., `\"needle-alpha\"`).\n335\t    #[value(name = \"worker\")]\n336\t    Worker,\n337\t}\n338\t\n339\t// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n340\t// Entry point\n341\t// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n342\t\n343\t/// Entry point called from `main`.\n344\tpub fn run() -> Result<()> {\n345\t    let cli = Cli::parse();\n346\t\n347\t    match cli.command {\n348\t        CliCommand::Run {\n349\t            workspace,\n350\t            agent,\n351\t            count,\n352\t            identifier,\n353\t            timeout,\n354\t            resume,\n355\t            hot_reload,\n356\t        } => cmd_run(\n357\t            workspace, agent, count, identifier, timeout, resume, hot_reload,\n358\t        ),\n359\t        CliCommand::Stop { all, identifier } => cmd_stop(all, identifier),\n360\t        CliCommand::Cleanup { all, identifier } => cmd_cleanup(all, identifier),\n361\t        CliCommand::List { format } => cmd_list(format),\n362\t        CliCommand::Attach { identifier } => cmd_attach(&identifier),\n363\t        CliCommand::Status {\n364\t            format,\n365\t            by_worker,\n366\t            cost,\n367\t            since,\n368\t            until,\n369\t            idle_strands,\n370\t        } => cmd_status(format, by_worker, cost, since, until, idle_strands),\n371\t        CliCommand::Logs {\n372\t            follow,\n373\t            filter,\n374\t            since,\n375\t            until,\n376\t            format,\n377\t        } => cmd_logs(follow, filter, since, until, format),\n378\t        CliCommand::ConfigCmd {\n379\t            get,\n380\t            dump,\n381\t            show_source,\n382\t        } => cmd_config(get, dump, show_source),\n383\t        CliCommand::Doctor { repair, workspace } => cmd_doctor(repair, workspace),\n384\t        CliCommand::Init => cmd_init(),\n385\t        CliCommand::Version => {\n386\t            cmd_version();\n387\t            Ok(())\n388\t        }\n389\t        CliCommand::TestAgent { name } => cmd_test_agent(&name),\n390\t        CliCommand::Canary { status } => cmd_canary(status),\n391\t        CliCommand::Upgrade { check } => cmd_upgrade(check),\n392\t        CliCommand::Rollback => cmd_rollback(),\n393\t        CliCommand::Reflect { workspace, force } =>        until,\n399\t            format,\n400\t        } => cmd_stats(by, since, until, format),\n401\t        CliCommand::Supervise { workspace } => cmd_supervise(workspace),\n402\t    }\n403\t}\n404\t\n405\t// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n406\t// Command handlers\n407\t// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n408\t\n409\t/// `needle run` — launch a worker.\n410\t///\n411\t/// Always creates dedicated tmux sessions for workers, even when invoked from\n412\t/// inside an existing tmux session. The only exception is a re-entrant inner\n413\t/// invocation launched by `launch_in_tmux()`, which is identified by the\n414\t/// `NEEDLE_INNER=1` environment variable and runs the worker directly.\n415\tfn cmd_run(\n416\t    workspace: Option<PathBuf>,\n417\t    agent: Option<String>,\n418\t    count: u32,\n419\t    identifier: Option<String>,\n420\t    timeout: Option<u64>,\n421\t    resume: bool,\n422\t    hot_reload: Option<bool>,\n423\t) -> Result<()> {\n424\t    // Determine workspace root (CLI arg → canonicalized, else global default).\n425\t    let workspace_root = if let Some(ref ws) = workspace {\n426\t        ws.canonicalize().unwrap_or_else(|_| ws.clone())\n427\t    } else {\n428\t        let global = ConfigLoader::load_global()?;\n429\t        global.workspace.default.clone()\n430\t    };\n431\t\n432\t    // Load full resolved config (global → workspace .needle.yaml → env → CLI).\n433\t    let cli_overrides = CliOverrides {\n434\t        workspace: Some(workspace_root.clone()),\n435\t        agent_binary: agent.clone(),\n436\t        max_workers: None,\n437\t        ..Default::default()\n438\t    };\n439\t    let (mut config, _) = ConfigLoader::load_resolved(&workspace_root, cli_overrides)?;\n440\t\n441\t    if let Some(t) = timeout {\n442\t        config.agent.timeout = t;\n443\t    }\n444\t\n445\t    if let Some(hr) = hot_reload {\n446\t        config.self_modification.hot_reload = hr;\n447\t    }\n448\t\n449\t    if resume {\n450\t        // Hot-reload resume: inherit worker identity from --identifier,\n451\t        // load state from heartbeat file + registry, continue from SELECTING.\n452\t        let worker_id = identifier\n453\t            .clone()\n454\t            .unwrap_or_else(|| NATO_ALPHABET[0].to_string());\n455\t\n456\t        // Load resume state from heartbeat and registry.\n457\t        let resume_state = crate::upgrade::ResumeState::load(&config, &worker_id)?;\n458\t\n459\t        // Emit upgrade.completed telemetry.\n460\t        let current_hash = crate::upgrade::file_hash(\n461\t            &std::env::current_exe().context(\"failed to locate own binary\")?,\n462\t        )\n463\t        .unwrap_or_else(|_| \"unknown\".to_string());\n464\t\n465\t        match &resume_state {\n466\t            Some(state) => {\n467\t                tracing::info!(\n468\t                    worker = %worker_id,\n469\t                    binary_hash = %&current_hash[..current_hash.len().min(12)],\n470\t                    beads_processed = state.beads_processed,\n471\t                    session = %state.session,\n472\t                    \"resuming worker after hot-reload\"\n473\t                );\n474\t            }\n475\t            None => {\n476\t                tracing::info!(\n477\t                    worker = %worker_id,\n478\t                    binary_hash = %&current_hash[..current_hash.len().min(12)],\n479\t                    \"resuming worker after hot-reload (no prior state found)\"\n480\t                );\n481\t            }\n482\t        }\n483\t\n484\t        let tel = crate::telemetry::Telemetry::from_config(worker_id.clone(), &config.telemetry)\n485\t            .unwrap_or_else(|e| {\n486\t                tracing::warn!(error = %e, \"hook telemetry init failed, falling back\");\n487\t                crate::telemetry::Telemetry::new(worker_id.clone())\n488\t            });\n489\t        tel.emit(crate::telemetry::EventKind::UpgradeCompleted {\n490\t            new_hash: current_hash,\n491\t        })?;\n492\t\n493\t        return run_worker(config, worker_id);\n494\t    }\n495\t\n496\t    if is_needle_inner() {\n497\t        // Re-entrant inner invocation launched by launch_in_tmux() — run\n498\t        // the worker directly inside the dedicated session already created.\n499\t        let worker_id = identifier\n500\t            .clone()\n501\t            .unwrap_or_else(|| NATO_ALPHABET[0].to_string());\n502\t        let agent_name = agent.as_deref().unwrap_or(&config.agent.default);\n503\t        let session_name = sanitize_session_name(&format!(\"needle-{agent_name}-{worker_id}\"));\n504\t        tracing::info!(worker = %worker_id, session = %session_name, \"starting worker (inner re-entrant invocation)\");\n505\t        run_worker(config, worker_id)\n506\t    } else {\n507\t        // Always create dedicated tmux sessions, even if already inside tmux.\n508\t        launch_workers(\n509\t            config, workspace, agent, count, identifier, timeout, hot_reload,\n510\t        )\n511\t    }\n512\t}\n513\t\n514\t/// Launch `count` workers in separate tmux sessions with staggered startup delays.\n515\tpub fn launch_workers(\n516\t    config: Config,\n517\t    workspace: Option<PathBuf>,\n518\t    agent: Option<String>,\n519\t    count: u32,\n520\t    identifier: Option<String>,\n521\t    timeout: Option<u64>,\n522\t    hot_reload: Option<bool>,\n523\t) -> Result<()> {\n524\t    let agent_name = agent\n525\t        .as_deref()\n526\t        .unwrap_or(&config.agent.default)\n527\t        .to_string();\n528\t    let stagger_secs = config.worker.launch_stagger_seconds;\n529\t    let max_workers = config.worker.max_workers;\n530\t\n531\t    if count == 0 {\n532\t        bail!(\"--count must be at least 1\");\n533\t    }\n534\t    if count as usize > NATO_ALPHABET.len() {\n535\t        bail!(\n536\t            \"--count {} exceeds the maximum of {} (NATO alphabet size)\",\n537\t            count,\n538\t            NATO_ALPHABET.len()\n539\t        );\n540\t    }\n541\t\n542\t    // Enforce max_workers cap (0 means unlimited).\n543\t    let effective_count = if max_workers > 0 && count > max_workers {\n544\t        tracing::warn!(\n545\t            requested = count,\n546\t            capped_to = max_workers,\n547\t            \"count exceeds max_workers; capping\"\n548\t        );\n549\t        eprintln!(\n550\t            \"Warning: --count {count} exceeds max_workers={max_workers}; launching {max_workers} workers\"\n551\t        );\n552\t        max_workers\n553\t    } else {\n554\t        count\n555\t    };\n556\t\n557\t    // --identifier is only meaningful for a single worker.\n558\t    if effective_count > 1 && identifier.is_some() {\n559\t        bail!(\"--identifier cannot be combined with --count > 1; identifiers are auto-assigned from the NATO alphabet\");\n560\t    }\n561\t\n562\t    // Detect existing sessions to avoid name collisions.\n563\t    let occupied = occupied_worker_ids(&agent_name)?;\n564\t    if !occupied.is_empty() {\n565\t        tracing::info!(\n566\t            occupied = ?occupied,\n567\t            \"found existing worker sessions\"\n568\t        );\n569\t    }\n570\t\n571\t    // Reject --identifier collision early.\n572\t    if let Some(ref id) = identifier {\n573\t        if occupied.contains(id) {\n574\t            bail!(\n575\t                \"worker '{}' is already running in session 'needle-{}-{}'\",\n576\t                id,\n577\t                agent_name,\n578\t                id\n579\t            );\n580\t        }\n581\t    }\n582\t\n583\t    // Build the list of worker IDs, skipping occupied names.\n584\t    let worker_ids: Vec<String> = if effective_count == 1 {\n585\t        vec![identifier.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| {\n586\t            // Pick the first available NATO name.\n587\t            NATO_ALPHABET\n588\t                .iter()\n589\t                .find(|name| !occupied.contains(**name))\n590\t                .map(|s| s.to_string())\n591\t                .unwrap_or_else(|| NATO_ALPHABET[0].to_string())\n592\t        })]\n593\t    } else {\n594\t        let mut ids = Vec::with_capacity(effective_count as usize);\n595\t        for name in NATO_ALPHABET {\n596\t            if ids.len() >= effective_count as usize {\n597\t                break;\n598\t            }\n599\t            if occupied.contains(*name) {\n600\t                tracing::warn!(\n601\t                    worker_id = %name,\n602\t                    \"skipping occupied worker name\"\n603\t                );\n604\t                continue;\n605\t            }\n606\t            ids.push(name.to_string());\n607\t        }\n608\t        if ids.len() < effective_count as usize {\n609\t            bail!(\n610\t                \"cannot launch {} workers — only {} NATO names available ({} occupied)\",\n611\t                effective_count,\n612\t                ids.len(),\n613\t                occupied.len()\n614\t            );\n615\t        }\n616\t        ids\n617\t    };\n618\t\n619\t    for (seq, worker_id) in worker_ids.iter().enumerate() {\n620\t        let session_name = sanitize_session_name(&format!(\"needle-{agent_name}-{worker_id}\"));\n621\t\n622\t        tracing::info!(\n623\t            worker_id = %worker_id,\n624\t            sequence = seq,\n625\t            total = effective_count,\n626\t            session = %session_name,\n627\t            \"launching worker\"\n628\t        );\n629\t\n630\t        // Stagger: sleep before launching subsequent workers.\n631\t        if seq > 0 && stagger_secs > 0 {\n632\t            std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_secs(stagger_secs));\n633\t        }\n634\t\n635\t        launch_in_tmux(\n636\t            &session_name,\n637\t            workspace.clone(),\n638\t            agent.clone(),\n639\t            Some(worker_id.clone()),\n640\t            timeout,\n641\t            hot_reload,\n642\t        )?;\n643\t\n644\t        println!(\n645\t            \"[{}/{}] Started worker '{}' in tmux session: {session_name}\",\n646\t            seq + 1,\n647\t            effective_count,\n648\t            worker_id\n649\t        );\n650\t    }\n651\t\n652\t    let sanitized_agent = sanitize_session_name(&agent_name);\n653\t    if effective_count > 1 {\n654\t        println!(\n655\t            \"\\nStarted {effective_count} workers (stagger: {stagger_secs}s between launches).\"\n656\t        );\n657\t        println!(\"Attach to a worker with: tmux attach -t needle-{sanitized_agent}-<name>\");\n658\t    } else {\n659\t        let worker_id = &worker_ids[0];\n660\t        println!(\"Attach with: tmux attach -t needle-{sanitized_agent}-{worker_id}\");\n661\t    }\n662\t\n663\t    Ok(())\n664\t}\n665\t\n666\t/// Initialize the tracing subscriber with OTLP layer if configured.\n667\t///\n668\t/// This must be called before any tracing spans are created so that the OTLP\n669\t/// layer can export them to the configured collector.\n670\t///\n671\t/// Note: Shutdown is handled by the OtlpSink in the telemetry module, not here.\n672\t#[cfg(feature = \"otlp\")]\n673\tfn init_tracing_subscriber(\n674\t    worker_id: String,\n675\t    session_id: String,\n676\t    config: &crate::config::Config,\n677\t) -> Result<()> {\n678\t    use opentelemetry::trace::TracerProvider;\n679\t    use tracing_subscriber::{layer::SubscriberExt, util::SubscriberInitExt};\n680\t\n681\t    let use_ansi = use_ansi();\n682\t\n683\t    // Check if OTLP is enabled\n684\t    if !config.telemetry.otlp_sink.enabled {\n685\t        // No OTLP - just initialize with fmt layer\n686\t        let fmt_layer = tracing_subscriber::fmt::layer()\n687\t            .with_writer(std::io::stderr)\n688\t            .with_ansi(use_ansi);\n689\t        tracing_subscriber::registry()\n690\t            .with(fmt_layer)\n691\t            .try_init()\n692\t            .context(\"failed to initialize tracing subscriber\")?;\n693\t        return Ok(());\n694\t    }\n695\t\n696\t    // OTLP is enabled - create the OTLP layer inline\n697\t    // We create it inline to avoid type erasure issues with boxed layers\n698\t    let otlp_config = &config.telemetry.otlp_sink;\n699\t\n700\t    // Build resource attributes\n701\t    let resource = crate::telemetry::otlp::OtlpSink::build_resource(\n702\t        &worker_id,\n703\t        &session_id,\n704\t        otlp_config,\n705\t        Some(&config.agent.default),\n706\t        None, // model - not available in AgentConfig\n707\t        config.workspace.default.to_str(),\n708\t    )\n709\t    .context(\"failed to build OTel resource\")?;\n710\t\n711\t    // Create drop channel for tracing layer\n712\t    let (drop_tx, mut drop_rx) =\n713\t        tokio::sync::mpsc::unbounded_channel::<crate::telemetry::otlp::DropEvent>();\n714\t    tokio::spawn(async move {\n715\t        while let Some(drop) = drop_rx.recv().await {\n716\t            tracing::warn!(\n717\t                signal = drop.signal.as_str(),\n718\t                dropped_count = drop.dropped_count,\n719\t                \"OTLP tracing layer export failure\"\n720\t            );\n721\t        }\n722\t    });\n723\t\n724\t    // Build exporters and tracer provider based on protocol\n725\t    let (tracer_provider, ..) = match otlp_config.protocol.as_str() {\n726\t        \"grpc\" => {\n727\t            crate::telemetry::otlp::OtlpSink::build_grpc_providers(otlp_config, &resource, drop_tx)?\n728\t        }\n729\t        \"http\" | \"http/protobuf\" => {\n730\t            crate::telemetry::otlp::OtlpSink::build_http_providers(otlp_config, &resource, drop_tx)?\n731\t        }\n732\t        other => anyhow::bail!(\"invalid OTLP protocol: {other}, must be 'grpc' or `input.file_path`\n33\t/// - `Grep`, `Glob` → `input.path`\n34\t/// - All other tools → `None`\n35\tpub fn extract_path(tool: &str, input: &Value) -> Option<String> {\n36\t    match tool {\n37\t        \"Read\" | \"Edit\" | \"Write\" => input.get(\"file_path\")?.as_str().map(str::to_owned),\n38\t        \"Grep\" | \"Glob\" => input.get(\"path\")?.as_str().map(str::to_owned),\n39\t        _ => None,\n40\t    }\n41\t}\n42\t\n43\t// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n44\t// Line processor (pub for unit tests)\n45\t// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n46\t\n47\t/// Parse one line of Claude's `--output-format json` output and return any\n48\t/// normalized [`AgentEvent`]s it produces.\n49\t///\n50\t/// `tool_name_map` is updated whenever a `tool_use` block is seen so that the\n51\t/// corresponding `tool_result` (which arrives later) can look up the tool name.\n52\tpub fn process_line(\n53\t    line: &str,\n54\t    tool_name_map: &mut HashMap<String, String>,\n55\t    ts: f64,\n56\t) -> Vec<AgentEvent> {\n57\t    let value: Value = match serde_json::from_str(line) {\n58\t        Ok(v) => v,\n59\t        Err(e) => {\n60\t            eprintln!(\"needle-transform-claude: skipping malformed JSON ({e}): {line}\");\n61\t            return vec![];\n62\t        }\n63\t    };\n64\t\n65\t    match value.get(\"type\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {\n66\t        Some(\"assistant\") => process_assistant(&value, tool_name_map, ts),\n67\t        Some(\"user\") => process_user(&value, tool_name_map, ts),\n68\t        Some(\"result\") => process_result(&value, ts),\n69\t        Some(\"error\") => process_error(&value, ts),\n70\t        Some(_) => vec![], // system, etc. — skip silently\n71\t        None => {\n72\t            eprintln!(\"needle-transform-claude: skipping line without `type` field\");\n73\t            vec![]\n74\t        }\n75\t    }\n76\t}\n77\t\n78\t// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n79\t// Per-type handlers\n80\t// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n81\t\n82\tfn process_assistant(\n83\t    value: &Value,\n84\t    tool_name_map: &mut HashMap<String, String>,\n85\t    ts: f64,\n86\t) -> Vec<AgentEvent> {\n87\t    let mut events: Vec<AgentEvent> = vec![];\n88\t\n89\t    let message = match value.get(\"message\") {\n90\t        Some(m) => m,\n91\t        None => return events,\n92\t    };\n93\t\n94\t    let model = message\n95\t        .get(\"model\")\n96\t        .and_then(|m| m.as_str())\n97\t        .unwrap_or(\"unknown\")\n98\t        .to_owned();\n99\t\n100\t    // Process content blocks in order.\n101\t    if let Some(blocks) = message.get(\"content\").and_then(|c| c.as_array()) {\n102\t        for block in blocks {\n103\t            let block_type = block.get(\"type\").and_then(|t| t.as_str()).unwrap_or(\"\");\n104\t\n105\t            match block_type {\n106\t                \"tool_use\" => {\n107\t                    let tool = block\n108\t                        .get(\"name\")\n109\t                        .and_then(|n| n.as_str())\n110\t                        .unwrap_or(\"unknown\")\n111\t                        .to_owned();\n112\t                    let id = block\n113\t                        .get(\"id\")\n114\t                        .and_then(|id| id.as_str())\n115\t                        .unwrap_or(\"\")\n116\t                        .to_owned();\n117\t                    let input = block.get(\"input\").cloned();\n118\t\n119\t                    // Store mapping so the matching tool_result can find the name.\n120\t                    if !id.is_empty() {\n121\t                        tool_name_map.insert(id, tool.clone());\n122\t                    }\n123\t\n124\t                    let path = input.as_ref().and_then(|inp| extract_path(&tool, inp));\n125\t\n126\t                    events.push(AgentEvent {\n127\t                        schema_version: SCHEMA_VERSION,\n128\t                        ts,\n129\t                        payload: EventPayload::ToolCall(ToolCallEvent {\n130\t                            tool,\n131\t                            path,\n132\t                            args: input,\n133\t                        }),\n134\t                    });\n135\t                }\n136\t                \"text\" => {\n137\t                    let text = block.get(\"text\").and_then(|t| t.as_str()).unwrap_or(\"\");\n138\t                    if !text.is_empty() {\n139\t                        events.push(AgentEvent {\n140\t                            schema_version: SCHEMA_VERSION,\n141\t                            ts,\n142\t                            payload: EventPayload::AgentMessage(AgentMessageEvent {\n143\t                                role: MessageRole::Assistant,\n144\t                                content: text.to_owned(),\n145\t                            }),\n146\t                        });\n147\t                    }\n148\t                }\n149\t                _ => {} // skip unknown block types\n150\t            }\n151\t        }\n152\t    }\n153\t\n154\t    // Emit token usage from this message turn.\n155\t    if let Some(usage) = message.get(\"usage\") {\n156\t        let input_tokens = usage\n157\t            .get(\"input_tokens\")\n158\t            .and_then(|t| t.as_u64())\n159\t            .unwrap_or(0);\n160\t        let output_tokens = usage\n161\t            .get(\"output_tokens\")\n162\t            .and_then(|t| t.as_u64())\n163\t            .unwrap_or(0);\n164\t        let cache_read = usage\n165\t            .get(\"cache_read_input_tokens\")\n166\t            .and_then(|t| t.as_u64());\n167\t        let cache_write = usage\n168\t            .get(\"cache_creation_input_tokens\")\n169\t            .and_then(|t| t.as_u64());\n170\t\n171\t        if input_tokens > 0 || output_tokens > 0 {\n172\t            events.push(AgentEvent {\n173\t                schema_version: SCHEMA_VERSION,\n174\t                ts,\n175\t                payload: EventPayload::Tokens(TokensEvent {\n176\t                    input: input_tokens,\n177\t                    output: output_tokens,\n178\t                    model,\n179\t                    cache_read: cache_read.filter(|&v| v > 0),\n180\t                    cache_write: cache_write.filter(|&v| v > 0),\n181\t                }),\n182\t            });\n183\t        }\n184\t    }\n185\t\n186\t    events\n187\t}\n188\t\n189\tfn process_user(\n190\t    value: &Value,\n191\t    tool_name_map: &HashMap<String, String>,\n192\t    ts: f64,\n193\t) -> Vec<AgentEvent> {\n194\t    let mut events: Vec<AgentEvent> = vec![];\n195\t\n196\t    let message = match value.get(\"message\") {\n197\t        Some(m) => m,\n198\t        None => return events,\n199\t    };\n200\t\n201\t    let blocks = match message.get(\"content\").and_then(|c| c.as_array()) {\n202\t        Some(b) => b,\n203\t        None => return events,\n204\t    };\n205\t\n206\t    for block in blocks {\n207\t        if block.get(\"type\").and_then(|t| t.as_str()) != Some(\"tool_result\") {\n208\t            continue;\n209\t        }\n210\t\n211\t        let tool_use_id = block\n212\t            .get(\"tool_use_id\")\n213\t            .and_then(|id| id.as_str())\n214\t            .unwrap_or(\"\");\n215\t        let tool = tool_name_map\n216\t            .get(tool_use_id)\n217\t            .cloned()\n218\t            .unwrap_or_else(|| \"unknown\".to_owned());\n219\t        let is_error = block\n220\t            .get(\"is_error\")\n221\t            .and_then(|e| e.as_bool())\n222\t            .unwrap_or(false);\n223\t        let output = extract_tool_result_output(block);\n224\t\n225\t        events.push(AgentEvent {\n226\t            schema_version: SCHEMA_VERSION,\n227\t            ts,\n228\t            payload: EventPayload::ToolResult(ToolResultEvent {\n229\t                tool,\n230\t                success: !is_error,\n231\t                output,\n232\t            }),\n233\t        });\n234\t    }\n235\t\n236\t    events\n237\t}\n238\t\n239\t/// Extract a short human-readable summary from a tool result content block.\n240\t/// Truncates at 500 characters.\n241\tfn extract_tool_result_output(block: &Value) -> Option<String> {\n242\t    let content = block.get(\"content\")?;\n243\t    let text = match content {\n244\t        Value::String(s) => s.clone(),\n245\t        Value::Array(arr) => arr\n246\t            .iter()\n247\t            .filter_map(|item| {\n248\t                if item.get(\"type\").and_then(|t| t.as_str()) == Some(\"text\") {\n249\t                    item.get(\"text\").and_then(|t| t.as_str())\n250\t                } else {\n251\t                    None\n252\t                }\n253\t            })\n254\t            .collect::<Vec<_>>()\n255\t            .join(\"\\n\"),\n256\t        _ => return None,\n257\t    };\n258\t\n259\t    let trimmed = text.trim();\n260\t    if trimmed.is_empty() {\n261\t        None\n262\t    } else {\n263\t        Some(trimmed.chars().take(500).collect())\n264\t    }\n265\t}\n266\t\n267\tfn process_result(value: &Value, ts: f64) -> Vec<AgentEvent> {\n268\t    let subtype = value.get(\"subtype\").and_then(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or(\"\");\n269\t    let is_error = value\n270\t        .get(\"is_error\")\n271\t        .and_then(|e| e.as_bool())\n272\t        .unwrap_or(false);\n273\t\n274\t    if !is_error && !subtype.starts_with(\"error\") {\n275\t        return vec![];\n276\t    }\n277\t\n278\t    let message = value\n279\t        .get(\"error_message\")\n280\t        .and_then(|m| m.as_str())\n281\t        .unwrap_or(subtype)\n282\t        .to_owned();\n283\t\n284\t    let code = if subtype.is_empty() {\n285\t        None\n286\t    } else {\n287\t        Some(subtype.to_owned())\n288\t    };\n289\t\n290\t    vec![AgentEvent {\n291\t        schema_version: SCHEMA_VERSION,\n292\t        ts,\n293\t        payload: EventPayload::Error(ErrorEvent {\n294\t            message,\n295\t            recoverable: false,\n296\t            code,\n297\t        }),\n298\t    }]\n299\t}\n300\t\n301\tfn process_error(value: &Value, ts: f64) -> Vec<AgentEvent> {\n302\t    let message = value\n303\t        .get(\"error\")\n304\t        .and_then(|e| e.get(\"message\"))\n305\t        .and_then(|m| m.as_str())\n306\t        .or_else(|| value.get(\"message\").and_then(|m| m.as_str()))\n307\t        .unwrap_or(\"unknown error\")\n308\t        .to_owned();\n309\t\n310\t    let code = value\n311\t        .get(\"error\")\n312\t        .and_then(|e| e.get(\"code\"))\n313\t        .and_then(|c| c.as_str())\n314\t        .map(str::to_owned);\n315\t\n316\t    vec![AgentEvent {\n317\t        schema_version: SCHEMA_VERSION,\n318\t        ts,\n319\t        payload: EventPayload::Error(ErrorEvent {\n320\t            message,\n321\t            recoverable: false,\n322\t            code,\n323\t        }),\n324\t    }]\n325\t}\n326\t\n327\t// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n328\t// Entry point\n329\t// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n330\t\n331\tfn main() {\n332\t    let stdin = io::stdin();\n333\t    let stdout = io::stdout();\n334\t    let mut out = stdout.lock();\n335\t\n336\t    // tool_use_id → tool_name, populated as tool_use blocks are seen.\n337\t    let mut tool_name_map: HashMap<String, String> = HashMap::new();\n338\t\n339\t    for line_result in stdin.lock().lines() {\n340\t        let line = match line_result {\n341\t            Ok(l) => l,\n342\t            Err(e) => {\n343\t                eprintln!(\"needle-transform-claude: stdin read error: {e}\");\n344\t                break;\n345\t            }\n346\t        };\n347\t\n348\t        let line = line.trim();\n349\t        if line.is_empty() {\n350\t            continue;\n351\t        }\n352\t\n353\t        let ts = now_ts();\n354\t        let events = process_line(line, &mut tool_name_map, ts);\n355\t\n356\t        for event in &events {\n357\t            match serde_json::to_string(event) {\n358\t                Ok(json) => {\n359\t                    if writeln!(out, \"{json}\").is_err() {\n360\t                        // stdout closed (downstream terminated) — exit cleanly.\n361\t                        return;\n362\t                    }\n363\t                }\n364\t                Err(e) => {\n365\t                    eprintln!(\"needle-transform-claude: serialization error (bug): {e}\");\n366\t                }\n367\t            }\n368\t        }\n369\t\n370\t        // Flush after each batch so downstream sees events in real time.\n371\t        if !events.is_empty() && out.flush().is_err() {\n372\t            return;\n373\t        }\n374\t    }\n375\t}\n376\t\n377\t//  .as_secs_f64()\n}\n\n/// Extract the canonical file-path argument from a tool's `input` object.\n///\n/// - `Read`, `Edit`, `Write` → `input.file_path`\n/// - `Grep`, `Glob` → `input.path`\n/// - All other tools → `None`\npub fn extract_path(tool: &str, input: &Value) -> Option<String> {\n    match tool {\n        \"Read\" | \"Edit\" | \"Write\" =>    line: &str,\n    tool_name_map: &mut HashMap<String, String>,\n    ts: f64,\n) -> Vec<AgentEvent> {\n    let value: Value = match serde_json::from_str(line) {\n        Ok(v) => v,\n        Err(e) process_assistant(\n    value: &Value,\n    tool_name_map: &mut HashMap<String, String>,\n    ts: f64,\n) -> Vec<AgentEvent> {\n    let mut events: Vec<AgentEvent> = vec![];\n\n    let message = match .unwrap_or(\"unknown\")\n        .to_owned();\n\n    // Process content blocks in order.\n    if let Some(blocks) = message.get(\"content\").and_then(|c| c.as_array()) {\n        for block in blocks
